On Windows e.g. C:\Program Files\SteamCMD\steamcmd.exe; on Linux e.g. /usr/games/steamcmd or ~/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh. 一行一条，可存多个账号的登录命令（例：login 你的用户名）。第一行 = 批量: One command per line; you can store several accounts' login commands (e.g. login your_username). The first login needs the password and email code typed inside steamcmd; once cached on this machine, only this command is needed to await verification. Passwords written into the command are stored in plain text in the local settings file — keep it safe. The account must own the game, or downloading its Workshop content fails.

What the six buckets are:
· Bucket ① Incomplete download — an empty folder left on disk (leftover of an interrupted download).
  Fix = download again.
· Bucket ② Ledger/disk mismatch — the ledger says "Downloaded" but the folder is gone from disk (deleted by hand or cleaned up by antivirus). Fix = download again.
· Bucket ③ Orphan folder — a folder named after an ID exists on disk but that ID isn't in the ledger. Fix = go to [Account Center] and click [Scan Game Folder]: the inventory lays them out as pending claims and adds them to the ledger once confirmed (folders put there by hand, with no download record, are claimed too); if you confirm they're useless, delete them by hand.
· Bucket ④ Dead remotely — the Steam API can't see the entry (result=9: author deleted/delisted/made private, etc.). Note: invisible to the API ≠ definitely undownloadable, so try downloading before acting (see below).
· Bucket ⑤ Query failures and suspected collections — a query failure may mean the entry was made private or the remote is flaky; retest later. A suspected collection looks like one mod but may actually be a whole collection, which needs expanding and confirming on the [Update Check] page.
· Bucket ⑥ Multi-frontend environment conflicts — cannot be detected automatically; check yourself against the list in the bucket ⑥ card.

Three ways in, one gate: ① terminal verdicts from a batch wrap-up, ② on-disk candidates found by an inventory scan, ③ IDs you registered yourself. All of them enter through "Confirm"; after confirming you can still undo it from the right-click menu.

To confirm: the verdict says the download succeeded, and it is only booked after you check and endorse it. To claim: a folder named after an ID exists on disk but the ledger does not know that ID (copied in by hand or fetched by another tool) — the inventory scan surfaces it and waits for you. Register: record "I want to download this ID" in the ledger with the status "Pending download". Version unknown: no version number could be read when booking it (for example the folder was empty) — it is filled in after downloading again and confirming in the wrap-up list. Blacklist: IDs that were cleared permanently or ignored; registering and claiming are both blocked; to undo, allow them again on the [Cleared Ledger] page.

Two views — [Group by mod] = one card per mod showing the timeline of its recent version changes; [Current comparison] = one row per mod, showing how far the confirmed version lags behind the remote one.
「更新 = 整个替换」：steamcmd 更新一个 mod 时不是打补丁，而是把: "Updating = full replacement": when steamcmd updates a mod it does not patch it — it deletes the old content folder entirely and downloads a fresh copy, so the old version is gone from disk once the update finishes. To keep a way back: choose "Backup + update" in the update confirmation list, or back up manually on the [Backup & Restore] page; you can restore the old version any time afterwards. The larger the "days behind", the more it is worth backing up before updating.
「落后」怎么看：落后 = 远端最新版本比本地确认版本新了几天（0 天显示“最新”: How to read "Behind": behind = how many days newer the latest remote version is than the locally confirmed version (0 days shows as "Latest"); "—" = version unknown (never downloaded and confirmed, or [Update Check] has not run). The locally confirmed version only comes from three front doors: batch wrap-up confirmation, claiming in the account center, or setting it by hand from the right-click menu — values read from disk never enter the ledger automatically.
想找“某天更新了哪些”：卡片标题上写着两个日期——「远端」= 作者发布现在这版的: Looking for "what was updated on a certain day": each card title carries two dates — "Remote" = the day the author published the current version, "Local" = the day the version was confirmed. Sort by "Remote updated new→old" to page from newest to oldest, or type a date into the filter box (for example 2026-09-26; typing 2026-09 covers all of September). Note that these are "the day the version is from" — for the day you ran a check or download, see "Snapshot time" in the card's snapshot table.
